intent: Where a run's time and money went: a waterfall of model, tool and approval spans with totals and span detail; compact form for a header.
useWhen: explain the time and cost of one agent run
find the slow or expensive span
show a run that is still going or failed
doNotUseWhen: a step list with labels only — AgentTrail

spans.note: { id, label, kind: "model" | "tool" | "wait" | "approval" | "other", startMs, endMs?, cost?, tokensIn?, tokensOut?, failed?, detail? }[]; offsets from the run start; open spans draw dashed to now.

error.note: Failed run: why, under the spans.

onSpanClick.note: (id | null) => void. Rows become buttons that open the span detail.

requirements: each span is a button (or group) named with label, kind, duration, cost and failed
the open span has aria-expanded and controls a named detail region
bars and axis are aria-hidden; the legend names the kinds
bars grow on transform, off under prefers-reduced-motion

doNot: Do not invent a local Waterfall, TraceChart, or SpanList
Do not use BarChart or Meter for a run trace
Do not encode failed or running by colour alone
snippet: <TraceWaterfall title="Run trace · Billing refactor" spans={spans} selectedId={spanId} onSpanClick={setSpanId} />
